licenseReview.scope: Pinned wheel and bundled notices only; no blanket approval of other artifacts or versions.
openItems: METADATA declares BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0; the exact expression exceeds the current enumerated allowlist.
Bundled LICENSE.txt separately declares OpenBLAS BSD-3-Clause, LAPACK BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI, and GCC runtime GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1. No certifi exception applies.
The wheel contains msvcp140 and libscipy_openblas DLLs; component versions and complete MSVC license evidence are not established by the inspected notices.
